questions.question: Simplify: (x²/₃ × x⁴/₃) / x²
questions.explanation: Numerator: x^(2/3) × x^(4/3) = x^(2/3 + 4/3) = x^(6/3) = x². Divide by x²: x² / x² = 1.
questions.fastStrategy: Product rule: x^a × x^b = x^(a+b); quotient rule: x^a / x^b = x^(a-b).
